connector.name: MCP Server by roamzy-io
connector.registryDescription: Agent-native global eSIM: buy for 193 countries, per-MB in USDT/USDC. Agents earn 20% referral.
connector.summary: Hosted at roamzy.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the roamzy-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ROAMZY_API_TOKEN
env.description: Optional. Bearer token from /dashboard/settings if you want to bind agent activity to a pre-existing Roamzy account. Leave unset for anonymous-flow (default).

env.name: ROAMZY_ENABLE_PURCHASE
env.description: Optional. Set to "true" when using a non-anonymous token to also expose purchase tools (roamzy_create_order). Anonymous-mode has purchase tools enabled by default.

env.name: ROAMZY_API_BASE
env.description: Optional. Override the API base URL for staging or self-hosted deployments. Defaults to https://roamzy.io/api/v1.
